item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I found no credible 2023 evidence of Putin personally running a sustained protection policy for women, children, minorities, or other vulnerable groups. The only favorable material is indirect humanitarian access and rescue activity, mostly through the ICRC or after specific crises, not a general protective system.","evidence":[{"title":"Ukraine","publisher":"International Criminal Court","date":"17 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.icc-cpi.int/situations/ukraine","summary":"The ICC said there were reasonable grounds to believe Putin bore responsibility for the unlawful deportation and transfer of Ukrainian children from occupied Ukraine. This is the clearest 2023 evidence against protecting children and vulnerable populations.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.1","2B.9"]},{"title":"Press briefing on crimes against humanity designation by Dr. Beth Van Schaack","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"22 Feb 2023","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/press-briefing-on-crimes-against-human-rights-designation-by-dr-beth-van-schaack-ambassador-at-large-for-global-criminal-justice/","summary":"The State Department said Russian forces and officials committed crimes against humanity, including execution-style killings, torture, rape, and deportation of civilians and children. That is direct evidence of targeted violence against civilians and children, not their protection.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.1","2B.9"]},{"title":"Russia - Ukraine international armed conflict: ICRC continues to help people in need","publisher":"ICRC","date":"14 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.icrc.org/en/document/russia-ukraine-international-armed-conflict-icrc-continues-to-help-people-in-need","summary":"The ICRC said increased military operations and the destruction of the Nova Kakhovka dam created additional threats to civilians and essential infrastructure. It also reported mine-awareness work, visits to over 1,500 POWs, and family-message delivery, but those are humanitarian mitigations, not proof that Putin protected vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.1","2B.4"]},{"title":"Putin accuses Ukraine of destroying the Kakhovka dam at behest of West","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"7 Jun 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-accuses-ukraine-of-destroying-the-kakhovka-dam-at-behest-of-west/1617195/","summary":"Putin ordered rescue efforts after the dam breach, which is the best limited operational response I found. But he blamed Ukraine and Western sponsors, so this is rescue without accountability or a broader protection posture.","question_ids":["3B.7","2B.9","3B.6"]}]}
